writeup: This new AIRTOK AP2801 pet HEPA air purifier is $49.99. The verifier matched the same model: 165 CFM CADR, 2240 square feet of coverage, 13 by 7 by 16 inches, and 7.7 pounds, with a washable pre-filter plus HEPA and carbon. Othercenter has the same AP2801 in stock at $138.61, Newegg at $148.99, and Filtrielle at $160.98, so this is 63% and about $89 below the lowest non-Amazon store price. Woot showed only 3 left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
